description: Window controls for the page-drawn header: drag, double-click and button toggle-maximise, minimise, close and maximise state query. Granted to the bundled app document (tauri://localhost, and http:// or https://tauri.localhost on Windows) and to the loopback sidecar origin the main window is navigated to, so the page can drive the undecorated window. The permissions are harmless window-chrome operations; the window itself is only undecorated in gblite builds.
